rationale: Pursuing noc/communication relief. Previous attempts to reduce area yielded no resource score improvements, and shrinking CPU caches slightly increased off-chip memory accesses from 184 to 186. Since expanding accelerator caches did not affect the off-chip accesses, they likely originate from the CPU side. Boldly expanding CONFIG_CPU_CACHES to '1024 4 2048 8' tests the hypothesis that a significantly larger CPU cache capacity will absorb more data and instruction fetches, thereby reducing off-chip memory accesses and overall memory transport pressure.
search_intent: Significantly increase CPU caches to absorb fetches and reduce off-chip memory accesses.
